value.rationale: Even though correct and new, the delivered witness is not independently worth retrieving under the shared STANDARD. Qualitative non-minimality of this pair was already decided by Lawlor-Nance (sum pi/2<pi), as DRAFT Remarks admit, so the headline adds only a non-sharp lower bound 0.351 from arbitrary choices: rho=1/2 unoptimized (any rho gives 2pi(1-delta0)rho^2), crude pi>3 and delta0<0.766 bounds, and non-sharp wedge estimate (true saving ~0.369 also unoptimized). Threshold 0.02 is topic-invented with 17x margin, showing it was a weak bar deep inside the non-minimizing regime far from the sharp boundary theta=pi/2, not a recognized benchmark. DRAFT explicitly disclaims adjacent angles, full boundary, sharpness, and uniqueness-of-tangent-cone use, and supplies no eigenvalue ledger promised as valuable partial target; the generic bridge works for a continuum of angles, making pi/4 an arbitrary slice. A future researcher could recompute this textbook ruled-surface estimate in minutes with no need to retrieve 0.351. Certification and replayability do not create value by themselves.
